title: Ngeli ya U-I (Theme 5: Ushauri-nasaha)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows nouns of U-I take u- for one and i- for many (mti umeanguka, miti imeanguka).
representations: real trees, rivers, mountains in pictures
steps: Is it a tree, plant or other U-I noun?
contexts: planting trees on a national tree-planting day

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes the singular and plural sentence.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mti mmoja ___meanguka." Kwa nini "i" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za U-I hutumia u- kwa umoja: mti umeanguka. Hutumia i- kwa wingi: miti imeanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Miti miwili ___meanguka." Kwa nini "u" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa mti ni miti, na kiambishi ni i-: miti imeanguka.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mlango mmoja ___mefunguka." Kwa nini "a" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mti na mlango ni vitu, si watu. Vinatumia u- na i-, si a- na wa-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-I?" Kwa nini "mtoto" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mtoto ni mtu, kwa hiyo yuko A-WA. Mti ni kitu na uko U-I.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mti mmoja, ___ miwili." Kwa nini "mamti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa nomino za U-I huanza kwa mi-: mti-miti, mlango-milango, mkono-mikono, mguu-miguu.
